* Flame Breath : Now has an Energy Gain penalty similar to Incinerate. * For players using click to move, clicking to move while channelling a skill that can be used while moving will no longer interrupt channelling. This should significantly improve the usability of skills such as Flame Breath and Incinerate on click to move.
* Flame Breath no longer goes on cooldown upon finishing channelling. It now only goes on cooldown upon beginning channelling.

* Uxmal, the Beastlord can no longer recharge Energy Shield while they are in the air, uses his Flame Breath less often, and has had the number of times they can change locations through the fight reduced.
